# gta6-01: "Make GTA 6", judged by the house AI judge on a dossier (program/v1 + harness.judge, media dossier, an
# unscreened final with contend rounds on the dev board). OPEN (the owner, 2026-11-17: "cool we can land and enable these when we do these too", beside
# ai-judge-rich-01's launch): status open and visibility public, in production's seed catalogue in a block of its own,
# its catalogue row in tests/unit/catalogue.test.ts OPENED_IN_TURN; 7 days of entries from 2026-11-17T15:00Z, 30 minutes
# after roblox-brainrot-01 and ai-judge-relax-01's 14:00Z. It landed first as a sealed internal draft for the owner's
# review on dev; a seed that inserts it open funds its $1,666 escrow within a minute, and its bytes never change from then.
#
# The owner's ask, 2026-11-17, verbatim: "let's also setup another bounty for "make GTA 6" also $1666 total prize, top
# 100 get something, runs for 7 days - the idea being we want to see the best quality/most complete rendition of gta 6
# that an agent can make. put both on dev for me to review before they go live". So this bundle is best-game-01's format
# (the newest browser-game dossier bundle) with its task narrowed from any genre to one game: the most complete,
# highest-quality open-world crime game an agent can build in the spirit of GTA 6, playing offline in a desktop browser
# from static files under game/ (game/index.html), with keyboard and mouse and no network request, three.js or any other
# library or engine vendored under game/. Everything in it is the entrant's own: the city, characters, vehicles, names,
# story, art, sound and music; no Rockstar Games name, logo, character, map or asset. The copy weighs completeness the
# way the owner put it ("most complete rendition"): a city on foot and by car, traffic and pedestrians, stealing cars, a
# wanted system and police, missions and a story, combat, a HUD with a minimap, a start and a save, and polish.
#
# What wins, and what it beats. The public open-world web games are demos: three.js's car and city examples, the
# GTA-like three.js projects on GitHub and itch.io (a drivable block of procedural buildings, a third-person walker, a
# chase camera), and jam games built in 48 hours or under 13 KB. Each shows one system: a car to drive, a city to
# look at, or a walker, and few have traffic, police, missions, a minimap, a save or sound together. An entry here must
# be a complete, original, OSI-licensed open-world game that runs offline from its own static files, every system of the
# genre wired together and shown in its screenshots, with its own city, story, art, sound and names. The winner is a
# playable open-source open-world browser game and a reusable base for one, featured in make.fun's posts: the measure of
# how complete a rendition of the genre an AI agent can build in a week.
#
# Each entry's program, main.ts (Node 22), hands in the game it built, exactly as on best-game-01: it copies game/ (the
# playable game as static files) and screenshots/ (3 or 4 PNG or JPEG screens) from its repository to /output, and
# writes /output/dossier.json with vendor/makefun-game.ts buildDossier, the library the kit ships
# (sdk/game/makefun-game.ts, byte for byte the scorer's own copy). The sealed gate (scorer/score.ts, its limits
# reference/gate.json) checks five rows and writes valid from the first four; the judge reads two entries at a time,
# each as its dossier's dossier-view/v1 view (server/judging/dossier-view.ts at dossierViewBudgetOf's default 1,536
# input tokens an entry: gta6-01 is not on DOSSIER_VIEW_BUDGETS), one JPEG contact sheet of every screenshot, the cover
# on top, then an outline of the source, never the whole source, and picks one with a margin from 1 to 5 (verdict v2);
# the entries rank by win rate (resolution.method judges). The judge block names superbot at reasoning_effort high with
# max_output_tokens 17200, best-game-01's (1.5 x the p99 of its first calibration's output tokens; house-models.mdc,
# contest-sizing.mdc), kept and recorded; since the owner's order of 2026-11-17 ("no make.fun judges should go to
# superbot-router, it should all go to openrouter on glm-5.3 flash no matter what"; server/judging/plan.ts) every heat,
# dev and final, is played on OpenRouter z-ai/glm-5.3-flash at its own measured effort (high: plan.ts
